'''Dramath the Second's datacron''' was a datacron or [[Datacron/Legends|data holocron]] in which was inscribed information about the history and life of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Dramath the Second]]. It told about his life on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Nathema|Medriaas]], and how his [[Dramath|father]] was defeated and [[Death/Legends|slain]] by his illegitimate son and Dramath the Second's half-brother [[Tenebrae]], and how Dramath then fled Medriaas and came to the world of [[Rekkiad]]. It was buried inside his [[Dramath the Second's sarcophagus|sarcophagus]], located inside his [[Dramath the Second's tomb|tomb]], where [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] found it.
